rss-feeds.looks: An intro, a highlighted 'These are not AMBER Alerts' note, the national missing-children-alert feed on a pale card with a copy button, then every state's feed as a list of links in columns.
rss-feeds.use: Only on the RSS Feeds page. The feed links are built in; authors only adjust the wording.

fields.feeds: Which feeds to list: national and state (the usual), national only, or states only.
fields.language: Match the page (usual), English or Spanish feeds. Spanish feeds only carry cases with a Spanish poster.
fields.notice: Keep a line saying these are not AMBER Alerts, e.g. 'These are not AMBER Alerts.'
